page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.4xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance based on the arm64 architecture, powered by Alibaba's custom Yitian YiTian710 processor running at 2.75 GHz. The system provides 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs with single-thread execution per core. Memory is configured at 32.0 GB of total system RAM, yielding a 2.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. Cache specifications include 64 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 64 MB L3 cache. Cryptographic processing includes hardware AES support, though standard x86 vector extensions such as AVX or AMX are absent due to the ARM architecture. Networking is provisioned at a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth, and the instance operates under a KVM hypervisor without local ephemeral SSD storage or GPU acceleration.

Performance benchmark metrics show a pronounced strength in memory throughput, with the instance scoring in the top 25% on the PassMark memory evaluation and achieving 121.25 GB/sec on uncached large-block read operations. Core processing metrics rank consistently within average benchmark bands, registering 28931.94 in multi-core stress-ng tests and 12813.96 in PassMark CPU testing. Workload trade-offs emerge in cryptographic and complex vector operations; the instance falls into the lower 25% benchmark bracket for PassMark CPU encryption and prompt processing on medium-sized 7B LLM models, indicating less performance efficiency for high-intensity mathematical transformation tasks relative to general execution workloads.

The 2:1 RAM-to-vCPU distribution delivers high core density, rendering the instance cost-efficient for scale-out applications that prioritize parallel integer processing over heavy per-core memory capacity. The ecs.c8y.4xlarge is well suited for web serving, microservice clusters, multi-threaded text processing, Redis key-value datastores, and ARM-native containerized deployments. Conversely, workloads requiring local NVMe storage arrays, heavy cryptographic throughput, or matrix-bound AI model training represent suboptimal deployment choices.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by a 16-core 2.75 GHz custom arm64 Yitian YiTian710 processor paired with 32.0 GB of RAM and a 10 Gbps baseline network interface. The instance features dedicated CPU cores with a 2.0 GB per vCPU memory ratio, 64 MB of L3 cache, and hardware AES acceleration, operating under a KVM hypervisor without local SSD storage or GPU devices. Benchmark results demonstrate strong memory performance, placing in the top quartile of PassMark memory tests, alongside solid multi-threaded decompression and Redis transaction rates in the mid-tier range. However, lower scores in encryption benchmarks and medium-scale LLM prompt processing indicate performance trade-offs for heavily vector-dependent or cryptographic applications. The hardware balance makes this server type efficient for scale-out microservices, general web serving, multi-threaded text processing, and containerized ARM-native workloads.
